en.description:
The Kingdom of Gnawnia needs MouseHunters! Choose from dozens of unique mousetraps with their own elements and powerups. Arm your trap with magical cheese from all over the world, and end Gnawnia’s pest problem - one hunt at a time!

MouseHunt is an award-winning Idle RPG Adventure you can play anywhere, anytime. Check your trap throughout the day (and secretly while at work) or join friends and hunt together. 

*PLAY THROUGHOUT THE DAY*

Your trap will passively catch mice for you every hour, all day and night, or sound the Hunter’s Horn to begin a hunt every 15 minutes. Friends adventuring with you can also sound the Horn on your behalf; hunting is always easier in teams!

*CRAFT POWERFUL TRAPS*

Mix and match your cheeses, weapons and bases to make a winning mouse-catching combination! Mice from all around the Kingdom have different preferences, weaknesses, and behaviours. Study the enemy, craft the perfect mousetrap, and set your bait! Maximize your trap power to catch rare and elusive mice while on adventures!

*WORKIN' AS A TEAM*

MouseHunt is the only Idle RPG Adventure where teamwork goes all the way! Join multiplayer treasure map hunts and win rare and limited-edition hunting tools and mouse bait. 

Compete in tournaments and climb the leaderboards with your allies and become a tournament champion! Cover more ground when you hunt mice with your friends! 

*REGIONAL FRIEND HUNTING*

Don't worry if you need to dip away from the adventure while hunting with friends. With Regional Friend Hunting, your friends can sound the Horn on your behalf in nearby regions. 

Don't be idle in an Idle RPG - sound the horn and help your friends with their adventures!

*SEASONAL HUNTING EVENTS*


Something exciting is always afoot in the Land of Gnawnia. Your RPG is idle, but that doesn't mean your calendar has to be! Join us for the winter holidays for the Great Winter Hunt, or brew up creepy concoctions during our Halloween event.  Check back regularly for new events, updates, multiplayer events and more!

And that’s not all! MouseHunters also enjoy:

● Over a thousand ridiculous, fantastical mice to catch, from the mundane Grey mouse to fire-breathing dragon-mice and much more!
● Dozens of unique locations spanning the depths of the Sunken City to the Floating Isles, each with its own ecosystem, puzzles, and progression to explore.
● Hundreds of trap combinations. Mix and match trap types and baits to catch different breeds of mice.
● Frequent community and seasonal events, quests, and minigames. There’s always something new to explore.
● An incredible player community of hunters, traders, and cheesemongers to play, trade, and swap hunting tips with!

Check back every 15 minutes for a new surprise! Can you rise to the challenge and be a Legendary MouseHunter?

--

Follow us on Facebook for frequent updates and links to FREE LOOT!  https://www.facebook.com/MouseHuntTheGame

Join the Fan Discord for hunting strategies, or to make friends with your fellow Hunters!  https://discord.gg/mousehunt

--
